title: Latency and timeouts on billing-svc

detection.alert: billing-svc: p99 latency > 2 s for 5 min

impact: Requests slowed down and a share of them timed out on billing-svc
symptom: [ANOMALY] billing-svc 2026-08-24 17:58-19:08: billing-svc: 74 of 108 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-08-24 17:58 and 2026-08-24 19:08 UTC (peak error ratio 0.86 vs baseline median 0.0). 1 error templates, 0 first seen in this span.

_templates.macro: Terraform change downsized {resource} {old} -> {new}; at the next traffic peak CPU hit 100 % and queries timed out.
_templates.remediation: Restore {key} = {old} on {resource}; alarm on CPU and DBLoad before downsizing.

culprit.diff:
@@ -105,3 +105,3 @@ aws_db_instance.billing_db
 resource "aws_db_instance" "billing_db" {
-  instance_class = "db.r5.large"
+  instance_class = "db.t3.medium"
   tags = local.tags

rca.macro: Terraform change downsized aws_db_instance.billing_db db.r5.large -> db.t3.medium; at the next traffic peak CPU hit 100 % and queries timed out.
rca.micro: infra/billing-db.tf:106 sets rds_instance_class db.r5.large -> db.t3.medium on aws_db_instance.billing_db.
rca.remediation: Restore rds_instance_class = db.r5.large on aws_db_instance.billing_db; alarm on CPU and DBLoad before downsizing.

action_items: Require a reviewed `terraform plan` and a CloudWatch alarm for the changed AWS resource.
Alert on the error signature `c.f.b.repo.InvoiceRepository - call to billing-db failed: <*> <*> <*> <*> <*> <*`.
